x = int(input())
y = int(input())
n = int(input())

def compute_abs(val):
    return -val if val < 0 else val

numerator_candidate = 0
denominator_candidate = 1
min_difference = 1e15
target_ratio = float(x) / y

for denom in range(1, n + 1):
    left_limit = 0
    right_limit = 1000000000
    while right_limit - left_limit > 10:
        m1 = left_limit + (right_limit - left_limit) // 3
        m2 = right_limit - (right_limit - left_limit) // 3
        diff1 = compute_abs(target_ratio - float(m1) / denom)
        diff2 = compute_abs(target_ratio - float(m2) / denom)
        if diff1 > diff2:
            left_limit = m1
        else:
            right_limit = m2
    for i in range(left_limit, right_limit + 4):
        current_diff = compute_abs(target_ratio - float(i) / denom)
        if current_diff < min_difference - 1e-15:
            min_difference = current_diff
            numerator_candidate = i
            denominator_candidate = denom

print(f"{numerator_candidate}/{denominator_candidate}")
